_about: Built only from page text a research agent copied verbatim on 2026-01-19. Each rule carries its URL and a quote. Run Verify sources before relying on it: the quotes are checked against the live pages from your machine. Deliberately NOT included: any sound-off percentage (the agent found none on TikTok's pages), hashtag counts, price-in-first-3-seconds, or 'AI labels are required' (the cited help page says TikTok 'encourages' labelling).

tiktok_shop.textAdvice: Use large, easy-to-read on-screen text to reinforce the key benefits, instructions and special offers.
tiktok_shop.soundAdvice: Do not rely on voiceover alone: many TikTok users watch without sound, so the main message must also be readable on screen.

quotes.idealSeconds: O vídeo ideal de showcase de produto deve ter entre 15–30 segundos de comprimento
quotes.textAdvice: Use textos na tela para reforçar os pontos principais

disclosureRules.applies: when a video is completely AI-generated or significantly edited by AI, including realistic people, places or events
disclosureRules.action: Use TikTok's AI-generated content label (a sticker or caption also works). TikTok's help page encourages creators to do this.
disclosureRules.quote: we encourage creators to label content that has been either completely generated or significantly edited by AI

disclosureRules.applies: when a product video is completely AI-generated or significantly edited by AI, including realistic people
disclosureRules.action: Use TikTok's AI-generated content label when posting. TikTok's help page encourages creators to do this.
disclosureRules.quote: we encourage creators to label content that has been either completely generated or significantly edited by AI

shopRules.rule: Products on TikTok Shop's Prohibited Products Policy cannot be sold at all, and products on its Restricted Products Policy need prior approval (wording from TikTok Shop Brasil's seller page).
shopRules.enforce: Remind the seller to check the product against both TikTok Shop policies before making ads for it.
shopRules.quote: Products listed under the TikTok Shop Prohibited Products Policy are strictly not allowed and cannot be sold under any circumstances.
